name: Stuff 'Em and Stick 'Em
summary: Ember needs hay from Wheeler’s farmstead to repair worn training dummies. The recruits need sound targets for their battle training.

sections.title: Worn Targets
sections.body: At the training grounds, Ember needs hay to mend the dummies used by the recruits. Their wear may leave the trainees unprepared for battle. A farmstead outside the keep belongs to Wheeler, who may have hay to spare. Ember offers to compensate him for any supplies he can provide.

sections.title: Fresh Targets
sections.body: Ember expects to put several targets back in order as soon as the hay arrives. The recruits’ training depends on dummies that can withstand their practice.

faq.answer: Ember needs hay to repair worn training dummies at the training grounds.
Wheeler is the man who runs the small farmstead outside the keep, where Ember hopes hay can be spared.

faq.q: Why are the dummies being repaired?
faq.answer: The dummies are showing wear, and Ember worries the recruits may be unprepared for battle without repairs.

faq.q: Will Wheeler be paid for the hay?
faq.answer: Ember says Wheeler will be compensated if he can spare supplies.

faq.q: What will Ember do with the hay?
faq.answer: Ember plans to use the hay to repair several training targets right away.

attribution: In-game quest text: Stuff 'Em and Stick 'Em
